records.subject: 重制版希耶尔

records.subject: 重制版希耶尔
records.summary: She is a third-year student at Tohno Shiki's school, infiltrates Souya High School, and plays the role of Shiki's upperclassman.
rawValues: 远野志贵所在学校三年级学生

records.subject: 重制版希耶尔
records.summary: She is a seventh-ranked member of the Holy Church Burial Agency and later acts under the Executor name Ciel, with code name Bow.
rawValues: 圣堂教会埋葬机关第七位成员

records.subject: 重制版希耶尔
records.summary: Her appearance is pale skin, French-Japanese mixed ancestry, short azure hair, sky-blue eyes, and an apparent age of eighteen despite a body age of twelve and early maturity.
rawValues: 肉体年龄12岁但长得较早熟

records.subject: 重制版希耶尔
records.summary: She normally wears school uniform and glasses; removes glasses during Executor tasks; work clothing includes nun habit and annihilation battle suit, and the nun habit conveniently hides many Black Keys.
rawValues: 执行代行者任务时摘下眼镜
修女服方便藏大量黑键

records.subject: 重制版希耶尔 / 艾蕾西娅
records.summary: Roa's consciousness begins awakening at age twelve, causing impulses toward bodily destruction of others; Roa controls the town, collects blood, invites several Twenty-seven Ancestors, and Arcueid kills the fifteenth Roa during the France Incident.
rawValues: 罗亚控制全镇居民并收集血液
爱尔奎特介入击杀第十五世罗亚

records.subject: 重制版希耶尔 / 艾蕾西娅
records.summary: Her corpse revives after six years in Church storage because Roa's soul remains unextinguished and the world judges that the body must survive, granting continuous restoration.
rawValues: 遗体在教会存放六年后复苏
世界判定其肉体必须存活

records.subject: 重制版希耶尔
records.summary: Before Japan she has killed three Twenty-seven Ancestors and holds their Idea Blood rings; after sensing Roa's reincarnation she goes to Souya, purges vampires at night, infiltrates school by day, and targets Tohno Shiki as suspected Roa host.
rawValues: 赴日前已讨伐三位二十七祖
白日伪装学生潜入学校
疑似罗亚宿主的远野志贵

records.subject: 重制版希耶尔
records.summary: She is an excellent Executor of the Holy Church with strength to fight a Twenty-seven Ancestors Dead Apostle head-on; she uses the Seventh Holy Scripture in pile-driver, great-sword, firearm, and ballista forms.
rawValues: 正面单挑死徒二十七祖

records.subject: 重制版希耶尔 / 原理血戒
records.summary: Idea Blood rings can weave great magecraft or be consumed as a furnace core to supplement magical energy, at the cost of bodily burden and loss of humanity.
rawValues: 当作炉心消耗补充魔力
